target_customer: Mobile app engineering and release teams at companies shipping iOS and Android apps
problem: Mobile app releases involve app store review, staged rollouts, many tools and manual coordination, so releases are slow and risky.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription priced per app, starting at 400 dollars per app per month at the March 2021 launch

founders.name: Gabriel Savit
founders.background_notes: Worked on the first mobile app team at Rent the Runway per TechCrunch March 2021.

founders.name: Matt Varghese
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder met at Rent the Runway mobile team per TechCrunch.

founders.name: Isabel Barrera
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder by TechCrunch March 2021 but not on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Integrations with App Store Connect, Google Play, CI and project tools, plus release tracking; hard parts were store API quirks and build re-signing for rollbacks.

defensibility.rationale: Sits as a layer across a team's release workflow; CI vendors could add release management.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Bitrise built its own Release Management product in 2022 according to its forum post; Runway was acquired by Guardsquare in November 2026 per one news item.

market_need_then: At launch Runway had pilot customers ClassPass, Kickstarter and Capsule and over 40 production release cycles, and the founders cited release coordination pain from Rent the Runway.

branding.domain_note: Uses runway.team, not runway.com; the .com belongs to an unrelated company and RunwayML also shares the name.

identity.visual_style: Illustrated friendly graphics with aviation metaphors such as air traffic control and flight

branding.brand_signature: Aviation theme: air traffic control for mobile releases
branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launch page exists; no merch or community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Coherent aviation metaphor and playful voice, but a generic name shared with several larger brands and a .team domain.

outcome_analysis: A team from Rent the Runway's mobile group built release coordination tooling, raised a 2 million seed in November 2021 and grew to customers such as DoorDash and Skyscanner per its site. Its only disclosed round was the seed, and a news item dated November 2026 says Guardsquare acquired it with Bugfender, a likely soft or strategic outcome with undisclosed terms.
notes: Status shows Active on the directory but the company site announces it is joining Guardsquare, and one news item (the only source found) reports the acquisition; terms and exact date not found, so exit date is approximate. Seed 2M per TechCrunch; other reports say 2.1M; the Business Wire release returned 403 so the amount is from TechCrunch plus an aggregator title. Competitors: TechCrunch March 2021 names Bitrise and fastlane only as integrations, and no dated rival source was found, so the list is empty. Founder education not found.
